title: PDRN 1% Collagen Night Cream

seo.title: PDRN Cream 1% with Salmon DNA: Collagen Night Cream
seo.description: Rich night cream with 1% PDRN (Sodium DNA), collagen and copper peptide. Wake up to plumper, smoother, more revitalised-looking skin. For tired or less firm skin.

description_html:
An overnight cream pairing PDRN with hydrolyzed collagen and copper peptide for a firmer, smoother, more revitalised-looking complexion by morning.

  • PDRN (Sodium DNA) + Hydrolyzed Collagen - a revitalising overnight duo
  • Supports a firmer, smoother, more revitalised-looking complexion
  • No parabens · no mineral oil · no synthetic fragrance

Best for: skin that looks tired or less firm and wants to wake up plumper, smoother and more revitalised.

Size: 50ml
custom.key_benefits:
- Overnight revitalisation - for a fresher, more rested-looking complexion
- Firms & smooths - PDRN and collagen for firmer, smoother-looking skin
- Nourishes - a rich overnight texture with squalane
- Supports renewal - helps skin look renewed by morning
What to expect: a fresher, more rested look by morning; firmer, smoother-looking skin with nightly use.
custom.how_to_use:
Use in the evening as the final step in your routine. Massage a pea-sized to two-pea-sized amount (more for dry skin) over the face and neck to seal in your evening serums. Its rich, overnight texture nourishes the skin while you sleep.
For a complete overnight routine, apply after the PDRN Renewal Serum.
custom.clinical_research:
PDRN is clinically shown to soften the look of crow's feet by up to 23% in 28 days.
In a randomised, double-blind split-face study, PDRN outperformed retinol head to head:
- Up to 23% less crow's-feet wrinkle area in 28 days, vs 6–7% with retinol
- Visibly smoother from day 14
- 1.8× the gain in firmness and elasticity seen with retinol
- No reactions in 31 women with sensitive skin
Ye et al. 2026, PLOS ONE: 31 women, 0.1% PDRN eye cream vs 0.1% retinol, twice daily for 28 days. Results describe the ingredient, not this product.

custom.faq_items.question: What does the PDRN 1% Collagen Night Cream do?
custom.faq_items.answer: A rich overnight moisturiser with PDRN (Sodium DNA), collagen, copper peptide, niacinamide and hyaluronic acid. Used at night, it deeply hydrates and supports firmer, plumper and smoother-looking skin by morning.

custom.faq_items.question: What is PDRN (Sodium DNA)?
custom.faq_items.answer: PDRN, shown on the INCI as Sodium DNA, is a salmon-derived ingredient popular in Korean skincare. In cosmetics it is valued for its hydrating, skin-conditioning properties that help skin look smoother and more refreshed. This cream contains 1% PDRN (Sodium DNA), or 10,000 ppm.

custom.faq_items.question: When and how do I apply it?
custom.faq_items.answer: This is an evening step. After cleansing (and your serum), warm a pea-sized amount and press gently into face and neck as the final step of your night routine. Use nightly.

custom.faq_items.question: Can I use it with the PDRN Renewal Serum?
custom.faq_items.answer: Yes, they are designed to layer. Apply the PDRN Renewal Serum first, let it absorb for about 60 seconds, then seal with the night cream.

custom.faq_items.question: Is it vegan?
custom.faq_items.answer: No. PDRN (Sodium DNA) is salmon-derived and the formula contains collagen of animal origin, so it is not suitable for a vegan routine. It is free from parabens and mineral oil.

custom.faq_items.question: Is it suitable for sensitive skin?
custom.faq_items.answer: It is formulated without parabens, mineral oil or added synthetic fragrance, and contains lightweight silicones for a smooth finish. As with any new product, we recommend a patch test first.

custom.how_to_steps.title: 1. Cleanse
custom.how_to_steps.description: Wash with a gentle, pH-balanced cleanser and pat skin dry.

custom.how_to_steps.title: 2. Apply your serum
custom.how_to_steps.description: Apply your Skingenetix serum and allow it to absorb.

custom.how_to_steps.title: 3. Seal with the Night Cream
custom.how_to_steps.description: Press gently into face and neck as the final step of your evening routine.
